CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_company_locations(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_role text;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select role into v_role
  from public.company_memberships
  where company_id=p_company_id
    and user_id=v_user
    and verification_status='verified'
    and role in ('owner','admin')
  limit 1;

  if v_role is null then
    raise exception 'verified_owner_or_admin_required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', l.id,
    'name', l.name,
    'address', l.canonical_address,
    'city', l.city,
    'phone', l.phone,
    'hours', l.hours,
    'status', l.status,
    'created_at', l.created_at,
    'updated_at', l.updated_at
  ) order by l.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from public.company_locations l
  where l.company_id=p_company_id;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION media_internal.is_published_company_media_object(p_storage_object_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.company_media cm
    where cm.storage_object_name = p_storage_object_name
      and cm.status = 'published'
  );
$function$
